<!-- script for picturefill changing with viewport width-->
<script>
    /**
     * FF's first picture implementation is static and does not react to viewport changes, this tiny script fixes this.
     */
    (function () {
        /*jshint eqnull:true */
        var ua = navigator.userAgent;

        if (window.HTMLPictureElement && ((/ecko/).test(ua) && ua.match(/rv\:(\d+)/) && RegExp.$1 < 41)) {
            addEventListener('resize', (function () {
                var timer;

                var dummySrc = document.createElement('source');

                var fixPicture = function (img) {
                    var picture = img.parentNode;
                    var source = dummySrc.cloneNode();
                    picture.insertBefore(source, picture.firstElementChild);
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        picture.removeChild(source);
                    });
                };

                var findPictureImgs = function () {
                    var i;
                    var imgs = document.querySelectorAll('picture > img');
                    for (i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
                        if (imgs[i].complete) {
                            if (imgs[i].currentSrc) {
                                fixPicture(imgs[i]);
                            }
                        } else if (imgs[i].currentSrc) {
                            removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                };
                var onResize = function () {
                    clearTimeout(timer);
                    timer = setTimeout(findPictureImgs, 99);
                };

                dummySrc.srcset = 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==';

                return onResize;
            })());
        }
    })();
</script>
<script>
	// Add a Custom Function (REALLY useful)
	//.exists() function
	$.fn.exists = function () {
		return this.length !== 0;
	};
	// When ready
	(function () {
		//get form input and textarea label for jQuery example. For each of them...
		$('.formRow').each(
            function () {
            	// if label exists before it
            	if ($(this).children('input').prev('.labelItems').exists()) {
            		// store label text as var name
            		var inputText = $(this).children('input').prev('.labelItems').text();
            		//hide label
            		$(this).children('input').prev('.labelItems').hide();
            		//jQuery example the name (puts it in field as placeholder)
            		$(this).children('input').attr("placeholder", inputText);
            	};
            });
	}());

	// change position of subheader if there's a interior banner with contents
	$(document).ready(function () {
		var banner = $(".bannerMain--interior");
		if (banner.length > 0 && $(".bannerMain--interior").html().trim().length === 0) {
			$('.subHeader + .bannerMain--interior').parent().find('.subHeader').removeClass('fixed');
			$('.bannerMain--interior').remove();
		}

		// This will hide any parent nodes in the 3rd footer column if they aren't equal to "Members"
		$(".footerMain .column.med-7 .footerLinks > li > a, .footerMain .column.med-7 .footerLinks > ul > li > a, .footerMain .column.med-7 .footerLinks > li > span, .footerMain .column.med-7 .footerLinks > ul > li > span").each(function (index) {
			if ($(this).html() !== "Members") {
				$(this).parent().addClass("h-showMedUp");
			}
		});

		//This will set the MegaMenu item if it is found.
		$(".headerMain-navMain a[href='" + window.location.pathname + "']").parents("li.hasChildren").addClass("current");
	});

</script>
